title: Dependency Injection Container — Runnable Implementations
title_es: Contenedor de Dependency Injection — Implementaciones ejecutables
description: Runnable DI container in three languages (JavaScript, Python, Java): token registration, singleton/transient/scoped lifetimes, and a resolved UserService → UserRepository → Database/Logger graph.
description_es: Contenedor DI ejecutable en tres lenguajes (JavaScript, Python, Java): registro por tokens, lifetimes singleton/transient/scoped y un grafo resuelto UserService → UserRepository → Database/Logger.
